digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner and Pass-1 usage instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 call results discard per-call usage records, blocking token totals and per-criterion request counts in coverage.metrics and plan-review observability
The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) must return (findings, usage) tuples and all external call sites must be updated atomically to unpack them
Usage records must be aggregated per call with criteria attribution, multi-criterion chunks dividing token fields equally while counting llm_calls in full per criterion
run_focused_finder must return (records, findings, usage) with usage summed over internal run_bin calls, and its usage merged into BatchRunResult.outputs before sidecar emission
The sidecar payload must include coverage.usage with per_call (raw call records) and per_criterion (derived map) under exact documented keys
